One hypothesis only: the repair pledge and other formats are folded into it because they rest on the same initiative. Fit is FIT with qualitative dimensions (format/region strong, audience/values medium, commercial terms unknown). Strongest counterargument: only three slots per year via open application among independent creators, and no evidence of a direct paid partnership channel. Blockers/unknowns: Kestrel's budget and creator-partnership terms are undisclosed; Field Notes selection criteria are unknown; the 2027 application window opens only in November 2026.
